boundary_decisions.rationale: Catalog, language, policy, quality, lineage, privacy, resolution and assurance have different authorities, states, failures and exit; one administrative SKU cannot merge them semantically.
Clean room is a market label for controlled collaboration plus selected computation/privacy mechanisms; the product boundary is the governed collaboration promise.
TEE, MPC and cryptographic protocols can satisfy runtime requirements but do not own purpose, participant agreement, analysis approval or release authority.
Deterministic rules, classical probabilistic linkage and predictive ML are substitutable scoring methods behind typed contracts; none is a link or merge authority.

LLMs or tool-using agents may draft intent, locate evidence, triage work or explain typed results only when selected. Parsing, typing, solving, numerical execution, policy, qualification, authorization, effects and receipts remain deterministic and authoritative.

jobs: revoke suspend close export and verify exit
product_truth.negative_mission: Does not own source truth, participant identity, purpose or legal authority, general warehouse/query semantics, analytical method meaning, TEE/MPC identity, or permission to release merely because computation succeeded.
product_truth.sovereign_question: How can mutually bounded parties admit governed contributions, execute only jointly approved analyses under declared privacy and runtime guarantees, release only authorized outputs, and exit with complete evidence?

aggregate_invariants: every participant role authority delegation and revocation is explicit
every contribution retains source owner cut identity schema time and use obligations
analysis approval binds exact code query parameters participants and output profile
applicable participant restrictions compose without silent weakening
privacy accounting uses explicit unit adjacency mechanism and composition
secure compute mechanism never authorizes an analysis or release
execution and output release have distinct receipts
revocation and exit obligations propagate to dependent future effects

aggregates.consistency: one active edition closes all parties purposes duties and precedence
every effect binds exact contract analysis input runtime and authority editions
release requires a fresh explicit decision and never follows from execution success

concurrency_and_idempotency: contract editions use optimistic concurrency
participant and contribution admissions are idempotent by authority and cut digest
execution idempotency binds contract analysis input budget and runtime editions
privacy budget reservations serialize per ledger
output release is single-winner per candidate recipient projection
unknown effect completion is reconciled before retry

context_map.translation: import principal role delegation and revocation
import purpose permission prohibition and duty semantics
bind immutable contribution cuts and corrections
bind exact method contracts without transferring release authority
submit approved work and consume attested receipts
